title: The Painted Smiles
text: The faceless here have painted wide red smiles on their blank faces in thick greasepaint. They smile at you all the time, from doorways and windows and rooftops. Their smiles are cracking at the edges.

options.label: Smile back at them, hoping you smile the way they do.

outcomes.text: They are delighted. They give you gifts, still smiling.
Your smile is wrong somehow. Every painted smile drops at once.

options.label: The shrewdest paints a smile on their own face, to pass for one of them.

outcomes.text: They take them for one of their own and lead you out. The paint is hard to wash off.

options.label: Hurry past the smiling faces without meeting their eyes.

outcomes.text: The smiles follow you from every window until long after there are no more windows.
